description: ShipStation sync state recorded on each order

sync_status.label: ShipStation sync status
sync_status.description: Unset until the order is first sent. synced: accepted by ShipStation. error: last push failed, see last_error. skipped: not sent, either because the order has nothing to ship or because ShipStation has already shipped or cancelled it; last_error says which. canceled: cancellation was pushed.

order_key.description: Value sent to ShipStation as orderKey. Always the Swell order id, which is what makes repeated pushes idempotent.

shipstation_order_id.description: ShipStation's internal orderId, returned on the first successful push.

shipstation_order_number.description: Order number as it appears in ShipStation, including the configured prefix.

last_synced_at.description: When the order was last accepted by ShipStation.

last_error.description: Message from the most recent failed push or webhook. Cleared on the next success.

last_webhook_at.description: When a ShipStation shipment notification was last processed for this order.

shipments_count.description: Number of ShipStation shipments turned into Swell shipment records.

payload_hash.description: Digest of the order as last sent to ShipStation. An order update that would send exactly the same thing is skipped, which is what stops the app re-sending an order after every shipment it records.

resync_requested.description: Set from the dashboard to force a re-push on save. Cleared automatically once the push completes.
